# Al-Bukhārī — Ṣaḥīḥ, selected Names report

## Identity, edition and scope

The selected bilingual online witness is Sunnah.com’s Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 7392, Book 97, hadith 21 (older English reference volume 9, book 93, hadith 489). Its About page identifies the English translator as M. Muhsin Khan. The compiler belongs to the ninth century CE; the site gives his death as 256 AH/870 CE. This dates the collection’s historical horizon, not a verified date of the reported utterance. The report attributes the saying through Abū Hurayra to Muhammad; no independent isnād or manuscript authentication is claimed. The single complete report, chapter heading, appended gloss and publisher’s identification were read.

<a id="bukhari-sahih-sunnah-online-p001"></a>
### bukhari-sahih-sunnah-online-p001 — Enumerating the Names

**Paraphrase:** The report connects ninety-nine divine Names with a promised entry into paradise for the person who aḥṣāhā. The displayed English reads this through memorisation; the appended gloss likewise concerns retention.

**Locator:** Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 7392; Book 97, hadith 21; complete Arabic report and M. Muhsin Khan English as displayed, including appended gloss.

**Provenance:** Sunnah.com web retrieval; complete extracted response saved in bukhari-bm-web-retrieval.json after direct HTML access returned 403. Read 2026-09-08 against the identified online witness.

**Source relation:** Paraphrased.

**Status:** paraphrase-ready; no quotation admitted.

**Use boundary:** The passage does not enumerate the Names, prescribe beads or a timed recitation, or prove an exhaustive theological inventory. Reported promise remains religious attribution; no empirical efficacy or universal doctrine is asserted.
